name: Timer Trade
summary: This EA places alternating Buy and Sell orders on a fixed timer interval, creating a hedging position system. Each trade includes a Stop Loss and Take Profit, and the direction alternates between buy and sell on each timer trigger.
summary_zh: 该EA按固定时间间隔交替下买单和卖单，形成对冲持仓系统。每笔交易设有止损和止盈，每次定时器触发时交易方向在买入和卖出之间交替切换。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于定时器的时间驱动交易，每隔设定秒数自动开仓，交替执行买入和卖出操作，形成对冲持仓。入场条件完全依赖时间触发，无任何技术指标或价格分析，定时器到期即开仓。出场条件依赖固定的止损和止盈点数，止损较小（10点）而止盈较大（50点），风险收益比为1:5。仓位管理使用固定手数（TradeValue参数），没有根据账户资金或波动率进行动态调整。资金管理完全缺失，没有检查账户余额、已持仓数量或最大持仓限制，可能导致无限累积对冲仓位。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is purely time-driven trading based on a timer, automatically opening positions at fixed intervals with alternating buy and sell directions to create a hedging layout. Entry conditions rely entirely on the timer event with no technical indicators or price analysis — a trade is placed every time the timer fires. Exit conditions depend on fixed Stop Loss (10 points) and Take Profit (50 points) levels, giving a risk-reward ratio of 1:5. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size (TradeValue parameter) with no dynamic adjustment based on account equity or market volatility. Money management is completely absent — there is no check on account balance, existing position count, or maximum position limits, which could lead to unlimited accumulation of hedged positions.
pros: 策略逻辑简单直观，易于理解和部署
止损止盈比例1:5，单笔交易风险收益比较好
交替买卖形成自然对冲，一定程度上降低了单边风险
使用CTrade标准库，代码简洁规范
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and intuitive, easy to understand and deploy
Stop Loss to Take Profit ratio of 1:5 provides a favorable risk-reward per trade
Alternating buy/sell creates natural hedging, partially reducing directional risk
Uses the standard CTrade library for clean and conventional order execution
cons: 完全没有技术分析，入场纯粹依赖时间，无视市场状态
没有持仓数量检查，定时器持续触发会导致仓位无限累积
止损仅10点过于紧密，极易被市场噪音触发止损
没有检查新柱或交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性时段开仓
Bug：EventSetTimer参数使用TimerTime*100，实际间隔远超预期值
cons_en: No technical analysis whatsoever — entries are purely time-based, ignoring market conditions entirely
No position count check — the timer continuously firing leads to unlimited position accumulation
Stop Loss of only 10 points is extremely tight and easily triggered by market noise
No new bar check or trading session filter — may open positions during low liquidity periods
Bug: EventSetTimer uses TimerTime*100, making actual interval far longer than the intended value
improvements: 增加最大持仓数量限制和账户资金检查，防止仓位无限累积
添加技术指标作为入场过滤条件，避免在不利市场环境下开仓
增加交易时段过滤和点差检查，避免在不利条件下交易
improvements_en: Add maximum position count limit and account equity check to prevent unlimited position accumulation
Add technical indicators as entry filters to avoid trading in unfavorable market conditions
Fix the EventSetTimer parameter bug — should be TimerTime instead of TimerTime*100
Add trading session filter and spread check to avoid trading under adverse conditions

risk_points: 没有持仓数量上限检查，定时器持续触发会导致无限开仓累积巨大风险
止损10点过小极易被触发导致频繁亏损
EventSetTimer参数Bug导致实际交易间隔与预期严重不符
risk_points_en: No position count limit — continuous timer triggers cause unlimited position opening and massive accumulated risk
10-point stop loss is too tight and easily triggered, leading to frequent losses
EventSetTimer parameter bug causes actual trading interval to severely mismatch the expected value

summary_en: This EA places alternating Buy and Sell orders on a fixed timer interval, creating a hedging position system. Each trade includes a Stop Loss and Take Profit, and the direction alternates between buy and sell on each timer trigger.
